_comment: FR-VOI-06's held-out labelled set. Deliberately small and synthetic — macOS `say` synthesized speech, not real Pico vendor voice notes (none exist to draw from yet; the real corpus comes from discovery/production the same way cases.json's own extraction cases do, per CUE-PRD.md §8.2). Sentences drawn from this repo's own vendor-message vocabulary (LED screens, rigging, deliveries) so they're at least domain-realistic, not generic dictation-test sentences.
